name: Kirishima Takumi
source:
Takumi returns to Japan because of Sana and Tania follows him all the way to be with him.

[spoiler] Takumi does not realise his feelings of love for Tania and has always treated his feelings for her as a brotherly sisterly love and he only realised it when both of them nearly got into an accident but they managed to avoid it. [/spoiler]
translation:
